title: Value-Guided Search for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
authors_zh: Kaiwen Wang, Jin Peng Zhou, Jonathan Chang, Zhaolin Gao, Nathan Kallus, Kianté Brantley, Wen Sun
paper_type_zh: 长链推理价值模型数据发布与 test-time search 配方
best_for_zh: 研究 rollout/search trace、value model 监督、推理预算归因和开放数据审计的读者
one_line: VGS releases 2.5M math roll-in/roll-out pairs with correct, incorrect, and incomplete outcome labels, trains a 1.5B token-level value model, and uses it to guide 4,096-token beam-search blocks plus weighted voting.
VGS 公开 250 万条带正确、错误与未完成结果标签的数学 roll-in/roll-out 对，并用其训练 1.5B token-level value model 引导分块搜索；完整拒绝清单、历史搜索树及代码和模型许可证仍未公开。
why: It connects the full reasoning-data lifecycle—prompt filtering, failed and successful rollouts, token-level value targets, selector-guided search, and explicit compute budgets—while making the missing rejection manifests, discarded branches, and license gaps visible for audit.
inclusion_reason: This work exposes an unusually concrete search-data pipeline linking 2.5M labeled long-CoT roll-in/roll-out pairs, a released token-level value model, block-wise selection, weighted voting, and explicit inference budgets, making it a core example of rollout/search/test-time trace data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-context reasoning models can spend many tokens on repetitive or unproductive paths, yet search needs a signal that can rank partial continuations before a final answer is available. Existing process reward model pipelines commonly require a predefined step boundary and expensive labels at those steps. This paper asks whether outcome-verified rollouts can instead train a token-level value model that guides long-CoT search without declaring what counts as a reasoning step. The official record is the NeurIPS 2025 paper, cross-checked against arXiv v2, OpenReview, the author repository, two VGS-AI datasets, and the released DeepSeek-VM-1.5B model.

The central released data object is one OpenR1-VM prompt group. It contains the math problem, reference solution and answer, and 56 roll-in/roll-out pairs represented by token IDs, processed answers, boolean rewards, and labels for finished-incorrect, finished-correct, or incomplete outcomes. The paper reports about 2.5 million pairs after filtering; the public train split has 44,509 grouped rows. Incorrect and incomplete outcomes remain inside a retained group, but a group is removed if all 56 rollouts fail or remain incomplete.

The work belongs to Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because the reusable object couples repeated partial trajectories, outcome labels, a learned selector, block-wise search topology, and an explicit inference budget. It is not human step supervision, a proof-producing verifier, an RL policy-training study, or a release of complete inference-time search trees. The fixed rollout policy’s success probability is the learning target; neither the terminal checker nor the value model establishes that every intermediate reasoning token is valid.

The Card reaches L4 because the full paper and appendices specify the collection budget, labels, model loss, training run, search settings, quantitative comparisons, and failure cases, while official releases expose the grouped dataset schema, code, and value-model weights. L4 here records a well-evidenced pipeline and its audit limits. It does not certify the missing rejection manifests, undisclosed generation parameters, absent historical discarded branches, or unresolved code/model licenses.

长上下文推理模型可能把大量 token 消耗在重复或无效路径上，而搜索又需要在最终答案出现前对部分续写进行排序。既有 process reward model 流水线通常要先定义“步骤”边界，并为这些步骤收集昂贵标签。本文要回答的是：能否用经过结果核验的 rollout 训练 token-level value model，在不预先规定推理步骤的情况下引导长 CoT 搜索。官方依据为 NeurIPS 2025 论文，并与 arXiv v2、OpenReview、作者仓库、两个 VGS-AI 数据集以及已发布的 DeepSeek-VM-1.5B 模型交叉核验。

核心公开数据对象是一个 OpenR1-VM 提示组。每组包含数学问题、参考解和答案，以及 56 个以 token ID 表示的 roll-in/roll-out 对，同时保存处理后的答案、布尔 reward，以及“已结束但错误、已结束且正确、未完成”三类标签。论文称过滤后约有 250 万个 pair；公开 train split 有 44,509 个分组记录。入选组内仍保留错误和未完成结果，但如果 56 个 rollout 全部错误或未完成，整组会被移除。

本文属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为可复用对象把重复采样的部分轨迹、结果标签、学习式选择器、分块搜索拓扑和显式推理预算连接起来。它不是人工步骤监督，不是能生成证明的 verifier，不是 RL 策略训练研究，也没有发布完整的推理期搜索树。学习目标是固定 rollout policy 下的成功概率；终点检查器和 value model 都不能证明每个中间推理 token 有效。

本卡达到 L4，是因为论文全文及附录给出了采集预算、标签、模型损失、训练运行、搜索设置、定量比较与失败案例，官方发布又公开了分组数据 schema、代码和 value-model 权重。这里的 L4 表示流水线及其审计边界已有充分证据，并不认证缺失的拒绝清单、未披露的生成参数、未发布的历史丢弃分支，以及尚不明确的代码和模型许可证。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution in one sentence is: turn cheap final-answer outcomes from randomly cut long-CoT rollouts into dense token-level value targets, then use the trained value model to select 4,096-token search blocks and weight final-answer voting.

For data construction, four DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen sizes generate diverse roll-ins, while DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B is held fixed as the rollout policy. Each prompt receives 14 roll-ins and four random cuts per roll-in, producing 56 completions. Every rollout token receives the completed response’s three-class outcome label under a token-level cross-entropy objective. This attaches a trajectory-value target to every rollout prefix without claiming that the label identifies the first faulty step.

The feedback contract has two layers. math-verify checks the parsed final \boxed{} answer against the reference answer, assigning reward 1 only to a finished correct response; wrong or 16,384-token-capped responses receive zero reward. DeepSeek-VM-1.5B then predicts the probability that the fixed 1.5B policy will finish correctly from the current prefix. The first layer observes final-answer equivalence, not proof validity; the second approximates policy-conditional success and can be miscalibrated for stronger generators or subtle reasoning errors.

At inference, VGS samples blocks, scores their prefixes with the value model, retains a beam of width 2, optionally repeats search through DVTS, and applies weighted majority voting to final candidates. Relative to majority voting and best-of-N, selection can act before complete answers consume the full budget. Relative to conventional step-delimited PRM supervision, the data interface is random-prefix completion plus terminal outcome rather than per-step annotation. The direction is outcome-supervised trajectory values for budgeted long-CoT search, not a general claim that learned value replaces semantic process verification.

一句话贡献是：把从长 CoT 随机截断位置继续生成所得的低成本最终答案结果，转化为密集的 token-level value target，再用训练出的 value model 选择 4,096-token 搜索块并为最终答案投票加权。

在数据构造阶段，四种规模的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 负责生成多样 roll-in，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 则固定为 rollout policy。每个提示生成 14 个 roll-in，每个 roll-in 取四个随机截断点，共得到 56 个续写。token-level 交叉熵目标把完整回答的三分类结果传播到该 rollout 的每个 token。这样可让每个 rollout prefix 获得 trajectory-value target，但并不声称标签定位了第一处错误。

反馈契约有两层。math-verify 将解析出的最终 \boxed{} 答案与参考答案比较；只有正常结束且正确的回答 reward 为 1，错误回答或达到 16,384-token 上限的回答 reward 为 0。随后，DeepSeek-VM-1.5B 预测从当前前缀继续时，固定 1.5B 策略最终答对的概率。第一层只能观察最终答案等价性，不能验证证明过程；第二层近似的是条件于特定策略的成功率，对更强 generator 或细微推理错误可能失准。

推理时，VGS 采样分块，用 value model 对前缀打分，以宽度 2 保留 beam，可通过 DVTS 重复搜索，最后对候选答案做加权多数投票。相对多数投票和 best-of-N，选择可以在完整答案耗尽预算之前介入；相对按步骤切分的传统 PRM 监督，数据接口是“随机前缀续写 + 终点结果”，而非逐步标注。其方向是面向预算受限长 CoT 搜索的结果监督轨迹价值，而不是声称学习式 value 能普遍取代语义过程验证。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and pre-filtering. Start from the 94K-problem default split of OpenR1-Math. After manually inspecting 100 sampled problems, the authors define rules that require exactly one parseable boxed answer and automatic verification, and remove multiple-choice, multipart, link-containing, ambiguous, or otherwise unverifiable tasks. The released OpenR1-Cleaned corpus has 49,394 rows: 48,394 train, 500 validation, and 500 test (Paper §2.2; Appendix D; official dataset card).

Roll-ins, cuts, and rollouts. For each cleaned prompt, sample 14 independent roll-ins from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, 7B, 14B, and 32B. The exact allocation across those four sizes is not disclosed. Draw four prefix locations per roll-in using the paper’s square-root-weighted cut-index distribution, then complete each prefix with the fixed DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B policy. This produces 56 pairs per prompt and 2.8 million pairs before post-filtering. Data-generation temperature, top-p, and random seeds are unknown.

Verification, filtering, and serialized output. Parse the final boxed answer and compare it with the ground truth through math-verify. Encode finished-incorrect as class 0, finished-correct as class 1, and incomplete/max-length as class 2; only class 1 has reward 1. Remove an entire prompt group when all 56 rollouts are incorrect or incomplete, eliminating roughly 10% of problems and leaving about 2.5 million pairs. OpenR1-VM exposes one 44,509-row train split with message_id, problem, solution, answer, reward, roll_in_ids, roll_outs_ids, processed_answer, and labels. It preserves negative outcomes within surviving groups, not the pre-filter rejects, all-failure groups, or a complete rejection manifest.

Value-model training. Initialize a 28-layer, hidden-size-1536 classifier from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, replace the LM head with a two-layer, three-class MLP, and apply cross-entropy at every rollout token using the terminal class. The paper’s final run uses 5 epochs, total batch size 1024, AdamW, cosine schedule with maximum learning rate \(10^{-4}\), and 16 nodes × 8 H100 GPUs for about 24 hours. It reports 35.7B total tokens and 14.4B loss-bearing tokens per epoch (Appendix E, Table 4). The repository’s four-GPU command is an example, not the reported final run.

Search and evaluation. Use SGLang to generate at most 16,384 tokens with temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95. VGS expands 4,096-token blocks, scores the new prefixes, maintains beam width 2, uses budget-dependent DVTS, and returns a weighted-majority-vote answer. Here \(N\) is the number of generations/blocks sampled in parallel, swept from 4 to 1024; it must not be confused with the 56 training pairs per prompt. The headline generator budgets are \(N=256\), 128, and 64 for the 1.5B, 7B, and 14B generators.

Reproduction and release checks. Pin arXiv v2, the GitHub revision, OpenR1-Cleaned/OpenR1-VM snapshots, DeepSeek-VM-1.5B files, upstream tokenizer, math-verify, SGLang, benchmark versions, and seeds. The public model needs the repository’s custom Qwen2ForClassifier; the model repo does not package tokenizer files or that implementation. Appendix E mentions a 500-example value-model validation split, but OpenR1-VM publishes only train. The checked repository does not expose an end-to-end collection/pre-filter script, full historical search trees, or licenses for code and model weights.

输入与预过滤。 从 OpenR1-Math default split 的 94K 个问题开始。作者人工检查 100 个随机样本后制定规则：必须恰有一个可解析的 boxed answer 且能自动核验，并移除选择题、多问任务、含链接任务、歧义题及其他不可核验问题。公开的 OpenR1-Cleaned 共 49,394 行，其中 train 48,394、validation 500、test 500（论文第 2.2 节、附录 D、官方 dataset card）。

Roll-in、截断与 rollout。 对每个清洗后的提示，从 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B、7B、14B 和 32B 中采样 14 个独立 roll-in；14 个样本在四种规模间如何分配未披露。再按论文的平方根加权截断位置分布，从每个 roll-in 选择四个 prefix，并用固定的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B policy 完成续写。每个提示由此得到 56 个 pair，post-filter 前总计 280 万个。数据生成的 temperature、top-p 和随机种子均为 unknown。

核验、过滤与序列化输出。 解析最终 boxed answer，通过 math-verify 与 ground truth 比较。标签 0 表示已结束但错误，1 表示已结束且正确，2 表示未完成或达到长度上限；只有类别 1 的 reward 为 1。若某提示的 56 个 rollout 全部错误或未完成，则删除整组；该步骤移除约 10% 的问题，剩余约 250 万个 pair。OpenR1-VM 仅公开一个 44,509 行的 train split，字段为 message_id、problem、solution、answer、reward、roll_in_ids、roll_outs_ids、processed_answer 和 labels。它保留入选组内部的负例结果，但不包含预过滤拒绝项、全失败组或完整拒绝清单。

Value-model 训练。 以 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 初始化 28 层、hidden size 1536 的 classifier，将 LM head 替换为两层三分类 MLP，并在每个 rollout token 上用终点类别计算交叉熵。论文最终运行 5 个 epoch、总 batch size 1024，使用 AdamW 和最大学习率 \(10^{-4}\) 的 cosine schedule，在 16 个节点 × 每节点 8 张 H100 上训练约 24 小时；每个 epoch 报告 35.7B 总 token 和 14.4B 参与 loss 的 token（附录 E，表 4）。仓库里的四卡命令只是示例，不是论文最终运行配置。

搜索与评测。 通过 SGLang 生成，最大长度 16,384 token，temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95。VGS 每次扩展 4,096-token block，用 value model 给新 prefix 打分，维持宽度 2 的 beam，按预算采用 DVTS，最后以加权多数投票给出答案。这里的 \(N\) 是并行采样的 generation/block 数，论文从 4 扫到 1024，不能与每个提示的 56 个训练 pair 混为一谈。1.5B、7B 和 14B generator 的 headline budget 分别为 \(N=256\)、128 和 64。

复现与发布检查。 应固定 arXiv v2、GitHub revision、OpenR1-Cleaned/OpenR1-VM snapshot、DeepSeek-VM-1.5B 文件、上游 tokenizer、math-verify、SGLang、benchmark 版本和随机种子。公开模型需要仓库中的自定义 Qwen2ForClassifier，model repo 没有打包 tokenizer 文件及该实现。附录 E 提到 500 个样本的 value-model validation split，但 OpenR1-VM 只公开 train。已核查仓库未提供端到端采集/预过滤脚本、完整历史搜索树，也没有披露代码与模型权重许可证。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All numbers below are author-reported or read from the official releases; no independent reproduction was verified. They support the paper’s data-and-search pipeline under the stated math settings, not a general claim that the released traces are intrinsically high quality.

  • Release scale and label conditions. Paper §2.2 reports 2.8 million roll-in/roll-out pairs before removal of all-failure prompt groups and about 2.5 million afterward. The official OpenR1-VM viewer exposes 44,509 train rows, each with 56 rewards, roll-in token sequences, rollout token sequences, processed answers, and labels. This validates the serialized scale and grouping, but not label correctness beyond the math-verify contract.
  • 1.5B generator at \(N=256\). Appendix C.1, Table 2 reports a four-benchmark average accuracy of 45.7% for VGS with DeepSeek-VM-1.5B across AIME-24/25 and HMMT-24/25, versus 39.7% for majority voting. On the two 2025 test sets alone, Table 1 reports 39.8% versus 31.6%. These comparisons share the reported inference budget; they do not measure the precision or calibration of token-level values.
  • Larger generators and distribution shift. Table 2 reports averages of 56.4% for VGS versus 50.5% for majority voting with the 7B generator at \(N=128\), and 61.0% versus 59.6% with the 14B generator at \(N=64\). The narrowing 14B margin is consistent with the authors’ limitation that a value model trained under the fixed 1.5B rollout policy can become out of distribution for stronger generators.
  • Efficiency. The paper reports average response length of 11,219 tokens for VGS versus 12,793 for the base DeepSeek-1.5B response, a reduction above 12% (Appendix C.7, Figure 15). Appendix H estimates classifier overhead at 0.024% of the 1.5B generator’s FLOPs. The latter is an analytical approximation and excludes some real systems costs.
  • Ablations and negative evidence. Reported AIME-24 sweeps favor 4,096-token blocks and beam width 2; DVTS helps at larger budgets, and random block selection underperforms value guidance (Paper §4, Figures 6–8). A qualitative rejected beam contains a critical error yet still receives value 0.337. These results show that the selector affects search, while also documenting that its score is neither a proof nor a calibrated guarantee for each trajectory.

The public repository contains value-model training and block-search code, and the model and both datasets are downloadable. However, benchmark gains cannot establish upstream provenance, completeness of filtered-out records, correctness of every label, or the quality of missing discarded search branches. Those remain separate audit questions.

以下数字均为作者报告值或来自官方发布，本卡未核验到独立复现。它们支持论文在既定数学设置下的数据与搜索流水线，但不能推出公开 trace 本身普遍具有高质量。

  • 发布规模与标签条件。 论文第 2.2 节报告：删除全失败提示组前有 280 万个 roll-in/roll-out pair，之后约为 250 万个。OpenR1-VM 官方 viewer 公开 44,509 个 train row，每行含 56 个 reward、roll-in token 序列、rollout token 序列、处理后答案和标签。这核验了序列化规模与分组结构，但标签正确性仍受限于 math-verify 的反馈契约。
  • 1.5B generator、\(N=256\)。 附录 C.1 表 2 报告，在 AIME-24/25 与 HMMT-24/25 四项基准上，使用 DeepSeek-VM-1.5B 的 VGS 平均正确率为 45.7%，多数投票为 39.7%。只看两项 2025 test set，表 1 报告 39.8% 对 31.6%。这些比较使用论文所述相同推理预算，但并未测量 token-level value 的精度或校准。
  • 更强 generator 与分布偏移。 表 2 报告：7B generator 在 \(N=128\) 时，VGS 平均 56.4%，多数投票 50.5%；14B generator 在 \(N=64\) 时为 61.0% 对 59.6%。14B 上差距缩小，与作者提出的限制一致：在固定 1.5B rollout policy 下训练的 value model 面对更强 generator 时可能发生分布外偏移。
  • 效率。 论文报告 VGS 平均回答长度为 11,219 token，DeepSeek-1.5B base response 为 12,793，降幅超过 12%（附录 C.7，图 15）。附录 H 估算 classifier overhead 为 1.5B generator FLOPs 的 0.024%。后一个数字是分析估算，未覆盖全部实际系统成本。
  • 消融与负面证据。 AIME-24 扫描结果支持 4,096-token block 和 beam width 2；在较大预算下 DVTS 有帮助，随机选择 block 不如 value guidance（论文第 4 节，图 6–8）。一个被拒绝的定性 beam 含关键错误，却仍得到 0.337 的 value。前者说明 selector 会改变搜索，后者则表明该分数既不是证明，也不是对每条轨迹都可靠的校准保证。

公开仓库包含 value-model 训练与分块搜索代码，模型和两个数据集也可下载。但 benchmark 增益不能证明上游来源、被过滤记录的完整性、每个标签的正确性或缺失的丢弃搜索分支质量；这些仍是独立审计问题。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is step-delimited process supervision: define reasoning steps, obtain human, LLM-judge, or repeated-rollout labels for those steps, train a PRM, and use it to rank candidates. Standard test-time baselines then sample full responses and choose by majority voting, weighted voting, or best-of-N. Both interfaces are costly for long CoT: dense step annotation scales poorly, while full-response sampling spends budget before selection can prune a path.

VGS changes the supervision object. A training example is a randomly cut roll-in plus a completion from one fixed policy, and the final three-class outcome is applied across the rollout tokens. The learned score therefore estimates policy-conditional completion success from arbitrary token prefixes rather than correctness of manually segmented steps. Search consumes that score at coarse 4,096-token boundaries, so the data-generation unit and the inference selector share a prefix-value interface.

The new element is not final-answer verification, regression via classification, beam search, DVTS, or voting individually. Nor is the paper’s main contribution simply collecting more CoT. Its concrete change is the combination of (1) multi-model roll-ins for prefix diversity, (2) fixed-policy rollouts for a defined value target, (3) dense token-prefix supervision from terminal labels, and (4) block-wise selection under an explicit generation budget. The 2.5M-pair release makes that interface inspectable, although its token-ID packaging and missing rejects limit some analyses.

For this track, the direction signal is that rollout data can train a selector for future search rather than only supply accepted SFT traces or a pass@k statistic. The approach also exposes a reusable audit question: a value target is conditional on the rollout policy and filter distribution, so changing generator strength, prompt mixture, or failure retention can change what the same score means.

Before reuse, compare against full-response majority voting and a matched-budget selector, verify math-verify edge cases, measure calibration across generator sizes, retain all-failure groups in a separate audit split, and record full branch decisions. Performance improvements alone do not establish that the token-level targets represent semantic reasoning progress.

既有基线是按步骤切分的过程监督：先定义推理步骤，再通过人工、LLM judge 或重复 rollout 为这些步骤取得标签，训练 PRM，并用其给候选排序。标准 test-time baseline 则生成完整回答，再通过多数投票、加权投票或 best-of-N 做选择。两种接口用于长 CoT 都代价较高：密集步骤标注难以扩展，完整回答采样则要先消耗预算，之后选择器才能淘汰路径。

VGS 改变了监督对象。一个训练样本由随机截断的 roll-in 和固定 policy 续写组成，完整回答的三分类结果被施加到 rollout token 上。因此，学习分数估计的是从任意 token prefix 出发、条件于该 policy 的完成成功率，而不是人工切分步骤的正确性。搜索在粗粒度的 4,096-token 边界消费这个分数，使数据生成单元与推理选择器共享 prefix-value 接口。

新的部分不是单独的最终答案核验、regression via classification、beam search、DVTS 或投票，也不只是收集了更多 CoT。其具体变化是四个部分的组合：（1）用多种规模模型生成 roll-in，增加 prefix 多样性；（2）用固定 policy 生成 rollout，定义明确的 value target；（3）从终点标签得到密集 token-prefix 监督；（4）在显式 generation budget 下做分块选择。250 万个 pair 的发布使该接口可检查，但 token-ID 打包方式和缺失的拒绝项仍限制部分分析。

对本分类而言，方向信号是 rollout data 可以训练未来搜索所需的 selector，而不仅用于提供入选 SFT trace 或 pass@k 统计。它也暴露出可复用的审计问题：value target 条件于 rollout policy 与过滤后分布，因此 generator 强度、提示混合或失败保留策略改变后，同一分数的含义也会变化。

复用前，应与完整回答多数投票及预算匹配的 selector 比较，检查 math-verify 边界情况，测量不同 generator 规模上的校准，把全失败组保留为单独 audit split，并记录完整分支决策。性能提升本身不能证明 token-level target 表示了语义上的推理进展。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Feedback and modeling limits. math-verify judges a parsed final answer, not the validity, relevance, or faithfulness of intermediate CoT. The token-level target repeats one terminal class over all rollout prefixes, so an early prefix before a later decisive error may receive a negative label, and a flawed path ending in the right answer may receive a positive label. Treating these values as semantic step quality would be a curator error. The qualitative score of 0.337 on a critically wrong beam also demonstrates learned-value miscalibration.

Selection bias and missing failures. All-failure prompt groups are removed because they provide no positive learning signal under the 1.5B rollout policy. This conditions OpenR1-VM on tasks that that policy can solve at least once and can underrepresent hard or systematically failing cases. Incorrect and incomplete traces are retained only inside surviving groups. Pre-filter rejects, the all-failure groups, full rejection reasons, and complete inference-time discarded branches are not published as a separate audit artifact.

Distribution and generalization. DeepSeek-VM-1.5B estimates success under one fixed rollout policy. Applying it to 7B or 14B generators changes the prefix distribution, and the reported advantage narrows at 14B. The study is limited to competition mathematics with boxed final answers; transfer to code, proof, open-ended reasoning, or different answer checkers is not demonstrated. Reward hacking through answer formatting or checker edge cases was not systematically stress-tested.

Attribution and reproduction. The authors report an 8-gram overlap check and use 2025 tests that postdate the underlying models/data, but comprehensive upstream OpenR1-Math decontamination is unknown. Exact allocation of 14 roll-ins across model sizes, data-generation decoding parameters, seeds, source snapshot pins, and the public identity of the 500-example value-model validation split are undisclosed. The end-to-end filtering/collection pipeline is not present in the checked repository, and the 128-H100 run and benchmark curves were not independently reproduced.

Governance and packaging. OpenR1-VM declares Apache-2.0, while OpenR1-Cleaned declares CC-BY-NC-4.0; the relationship between these terms and all upstream records requires review. No license was verified for the code or DeepSeek-VM-1.5B weights. The model repository lacks tokenizer files and the custom classifier source, so loading depends on the GitHub implementation and an upstream tokenizer. These gaps make direct commercial or policy-sensitive training reuse inappropriate without additional rights and version checks.

反馈与建模限制。 math-verify 判断的是解析后的最终答案，不验证中间 CoT 的有效性、相关性或忠实性。token-level target 把一个终点类别重复施加到全部 rollout prefix，因此，后来出现决定性错误的路径可能让较早的正常 prefix 获得负标签；有缺陷但最终答对的路径也可能获得正标签。把这些 value 当作语义步骤质量属于 curator 误读。一个含关键错误的 beam 仍得到 0.337，也直接说明学习式 value 会失准。

选择偏差与缺失失败。 全失败提示组因在 1.5B rollout policy 下没有正学习信号而被删除。这使 OpenR1-VM 条件化于“该 policy 至少能成功一次”的任务，可能低估困难或系统性失败案例。错误和未完成 trace 只在入选组内部保留。预过滤拒绝项、全失败组、完整拒绝原因以及推理期全部丢弃分支均未作为独立 audit artifact 发布。

分布与泛化。 DeepSeek-VM-1.5B 估计的是固定 rollout policy 下的成功率；将其用于 7B 或 14B generator 会改变 prefix 分布，论文报告的优势在 14B 上缩小。研究仅覆盖以 boxed final answer 表示结果的竞赛数学；对代码、证明、开放式推理或不同答案检查器的迁移尚未证明。论文也没有系统性压力测试通过答案格式或 checker 边界情况进行 reward hacking。

归因与复现。 作者报告了 8-gram overlap 检查，并使用晚于底层模型/数据的 2025 test set，但 OpenR1-Math 上游的全面去污染仍为 unknown。14 个 roll-in 在不同模型规模间的精确分配、数据生成 decoding 参数、随机种子、来源 snapshot pin，以及 500 个样本的 value-model validation split 对应哪个公开工件，均未披露。已核查仓库没有端到端过滤/采集流水线，128 张 H100 的训练运行与 benchmark curve 也未被独立复现。

治理与打包。 OpenR1-VM 声明 Apache-2.0，OpenR1-Cleaned 声明 CC-BY-NC-4.0；这些条款与所有上游记录之间的关系仍需审查。代码和 DeepSeek-VM-1.5B 权重均未核验到许可证。model repo 缺少 tokenizer 文件和自定义 classifier 源码，因此加载依赖 GitHub 实现与上游 tokenizer。未完成额外权利和版本核验前，不适合直接用于商业或政策敏感的训练复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, this work is a concrete reference implementation of a full selector-data lifecycle: source prompts are filtered, diverse prefixes are sampled, a fixed policy generates labeled continuations, a value model consumes the grouped records, and the resulting score controls block-level search under a stated budget. A new study can reuse that decomposition even if it replaces the math domain, verifier, generator, or search algorithm.

Practical uses include:

  • reproducing token-prefix value modeling with a three-class correct/incorrect/incomplete target;
  • comparing random-prefix collection with step-delimited PRM or Monte Carlo step labeling at matched collection cost;
  • testing majority voting, best-of-N, random block selection, VGS, and DVTS under the same generation budget;
  • building calibration and distribution-shift evaluations across rollout-policy and generator sizes;
  • constructing an audit split that restores all-failure prompts and preserves rejected blocks, so selector false positives and false negatives remain inspectable;
  • using OpenR1-VM’s grouped 56-response structure for research on negative/incomplete trajectory retention, subject to provenance and rights checks.

The appropriate reuse class is conditional research/training reuse plus a strong recipe/audit reference. OpenR1-VM, the value-model weights, and code are public enough to study the interface, but training or redistribution should wait for an explicit upstream-rights review, code/model license clarification, version pins, and verification of the missing generation and filtering details. The released value model is suitable as an experimental baseline, not as a domain-general or calibrated verifier.

Evaluation reuse should keep AIME/HMMT test items separate from any adapted prompt pool and preserve the paper’s budget definition. Do not treat \(N\), number of unique prompts, number of 56-way training pairs, and generated token count as interchangeable scale units. A useful replication should report all four, as well as selector overhead and wall-clock cost.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 而言，本文是一个完整 selector-data 生命周期的具体参考实现：过滤来源提示，采样多样 prefix，用固定 policy 生成带标签的续写，让 value model 消费分组记录，再让所得分数在明确预算下控制 block-level search。即使替换数学领域、verifier、generator 或搜索算法，后续研究仍可复用这一模块划分。

具体用途包括：

  • 复现以“正确、错误、未完成”三分类结果训练 token-prefix value 的方法；
  • 在匹配采集成本下，比较随机 prefix 采集与按步骤切分的 PRM 或 Monte Carlo 步骤标注；
  • 在相同 generation budget 下比较多数投票、best-of-N、随机 block 选择、VGS 与 DVTS；
  • 构造跨 rollout policy 和 generator 规模的校准与分布偏移评测；
  • 建立重新加入全失败提示并保留被拒绝 block 的 audit split，使 selector false positive 和 false negative 可检查；
  • 在完成来源与权利检查后，利用 OpenR1-VM 的 56-response 分组结构研究负例/未完成轨迹的保留。

适当的复用等级是有条件的研究/训练复用，以及较强的配方/审计参考。OpenR1-VM、value-model 权重和代码已公开，足以研究该接口；但训练或再分发前，应先完成上游权利审查、代码/模型许可证澄清、版本固定，并核实缺失的生成与过滤细节。公开 value model 可作为实验 baseline，不应视为跨领域通用或已校准的 verifier。

评测复用应将 AIME/HMMT test item 与任何改造后的 prompt pool 分离，并保留论文对预算的定义。不能把 \(N\)、unique prompt 数、56-way training pair 数和生成 token 数当作可互换的规模单位。有效复现应同时报告这四项，并补充 selector overhead 与墙钟成本。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Paper §§2.1–2.3 together: the value target, 56-pair collection unit, and block-wise search consumer are one connected data contract.
  • Keep three scales separate: 44,509 released prompt groups, 56 pairs per group, and about 2.5 million post-filter pairs; inference budget \(N\) is a fourth, different quantity.
  • Inspect Appendix D for filtering/cut selection, Appendix E for the 128-H100 value-model run, Table 2 for budgeted comparisons, and Appendix C.7/H for failure and efficiency boundaries.
  • Remember that OpenR1-VM retains wrong and incomplete rollouts only within surviving prompt groups; all-failure groups, complete rejection manifests, and historical discarded search branches are not released.
  • Pair this Card with work on PRMs, best-of-N/majority voting, and search-generated trace data; verify generation settings, validation split identity, licenses, model packaging, and value calibration before reuse.

• 应将论文第 2.1–2.3 节连贯阅读：value target、56-pair 采集单元和 block-wise search 消费端共同构成一个数据契约。
  • 严格区分三个规模：44,509 个公开提示组、每组 56 个 pair、post-filter 后约 250 万个 pair；推理预算 \(N\) 是第四个不同量。
  • 过滤/截断选择看附录 D，128 张 H100 的 value-model 训练看附录 E，预算化比较看表 2，失败与效率边界看附录 C.7 和 H。
  • OpenR1-VM 只在入选提示组内部保留错误和未完成 rollout；全失败组、完整拒绝清单及历史丢弃搜索分支均未发布。
  • 建议与 PRM、best-of-N/多数投票及搜索生成 trace 相关工作对读；复用前核验生成设置、validation split 身份、许可证、模型打包和 value 校准。

value.html: OpenR1-Math default split (94K problems) pre-filtered into the released 49,394-row OpenR1-Cleaned corpus; post-filtering leaves 44,509 prompt groups in the OpenR1-VM train split.
A math problem with reference solution/final answer plus grouped token-ID roll-ins and roll-outs, processed boxed answers, boolean rewards, and three-class outcome labels.

Four DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen sizes (1.5B, 7B, 14B, and 32B) produce 14 diverse roll-ins per prompt; DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B is the fixed roll-out policy that completes four randomly cut prefixes per roll-in.
Offline long-context mathematical CoT sampling for value-model training, followed by block-wise beam search or DVTS over DeepSeek generations at test time.

math-verify checks parsed boxed answers against ground truth; labels are 0 for finished-incorrect, 1 for finished-correct, and 2 for incomplete, while DeepSeek-VM-1.5B predicts the probability of class 1 for search and weighted voting.
A generation succeeds when it finishes with a parseable boxed answer accepted by math-verify; wrong answers and responses that hit the 16,384-token cap receive zero reward.
DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B initializes the 28-layer, hidden-size-1536 Qwen2ForClassifier value model; 1.5B, 7B, 14B, and 32B variants supply roll-ins.
unknown

For each retained prompt, sample 14 independent roll-ins, select four random prefix positions per roll-in, and complete each prefix with the fixed 1.5B policy, yielding 56 labeled roll-in/roll-out pairs.

Cut indices follow the paper's sqrt-weighted distribution, described as favoring earlier positions; response-generation decoding parameters and seeds are unknown. At inference, use temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95.
56 labeled pairs per prompt before post-filtering; 2.8M pairs before and about 2.5M pairs after removing roughly 10% all-failure prompt groups.
Training-data generation: unknown. VGS inference: 0.6 with top-p 0.95.
Pre-filter for exactly one parseable boxed answer, automatic verifiability, non-MCQ single-part tasks, and no links; post-filter prompt groups whose 56 roll-outs are all incorrect or incomplete.

Search uses a 16,384-token maximum, 4,096-token blocks, beam width 2, budget-dependent DVTS, and final weighted majority voting; reported sweeps span N=4 to 1024, with headline N=256/128/64 for 1.5B/7B/14B generators.

The value model uses token-level cross-entropy over three outcome classes for 5 epochs with batch 1024, cosine max LR 1e-4, AdamW, and 16 nodes of 8 H100 GPUs; inference uses SGLang block-wise beam search plus weighted majority voting.
OpenR1-Math is the sole named upstream prompt corpus, but it aggregates mathematical sources and the VGS paper does not audit every upstream source or right; OpenR1-Cleaned preserves a source field.
OpenR1-Cleaned releases train 48,394, validation 500, and test 500; OpenR1-VM releases one 44,509-row train split whose rows group the 56 rollout pairs for each retained prompt.

The authors report no training/test example with more than 50% 8-gram overlap and use 2025 AIME/HMMT tests released after the underlying models/data; comprehensive upstream decontamination is unknown.

items: A learned value can miss subtle but decisive errors; Appendix C.7 shows a critically wrong rejected beam still scoring 0.337.
Value guidance becomes out of distribution for stronger generators, and the 14B VGS margin over majority voting is small.
All-failure prompt groups and pre-filter rejects are removed without a released rejection manifest, biasing the dataset toward tasks the 1.5B roll-out policy can sometimes solve.
OpenR1-VM retains incorrect/incomplete traces inside surviving groups, but full discarded search branches and historical search trees are not released.
The repository advertises filtering code, but its current tree exposes training/search utilities rather than the end-to-end data collection and pre-filter pipeline.
OpenR1-VM exposes only a train split even though Appendix E names a 500-example value-model validation split; the matching validation artifact is not identified.
The model repository contains weights and config but no tokenizer files or embedded custom classifier implementation, so use depends on the GitHub code and an upstream tokenizer.
{'Mixed or missing licenses constrain reuse': 'the cleaned prompt corpus is non-commercial, while the model and code licenses are undisclosed.'}
The reported 0.024% classifier overhead is an analytical FLOP estimate and does not include every systems cost.
